units.source_text: 他这才了解到嵌在梯子之上的稻草包的用途。

en.t: Only then did he understand what the straw bundles fixed above the ladder were for.

units.source_text: 那里放下一根绳索，把大篮子吊上吊下。

en.t: A rope was lowered there, and the large baskets were hoisted up and down.

units.source_text: 平均四人一组管着大篮子，全部大概有两三组。

en.t: On average, four people handled each large basket, and there seemed to be two or three groups in all.

units.source_text: 大致上由年轻人组成，干起活来麻利，还有些得意忘形的样子。

en.t: They were mostly young people, quick and efficient at the work, and even looked a little carried away with themselves.

units.source_text: 一组大篮子装满，下一组大篮子已经准备好了。

en.t: As soon as one set of large baskets was filled, the next set was already ready.

units.source_text: 一共吊了六次，这才把隆起来的沙堆铲平了。

en.t: After six hoists in all, they finally leveled the raised mound of sand.
